Receptiveness.name: \str[120]'s Receptiveness
description: Measures how receptive \str[120] is to lewd requests from \str[121].
The base score is calculated from the various Hearts \str[120] currently has:
While in heat, gain an additional 2 points.
While in a good mood, randomly gain 0–2 points.
While in a bad mood, randomly lose 0–2 points.
